comment: Professor Lanham is the man.  He is nice, intelligent, and witty.  Very knowledgeable and has fascinating stories that compliment the course material.  Class is mostly discussion-based, and I always look forward to it.  Definitely take him!

I highly recommend this Professor. The class was easy and interesting. He gives you all the notes and lectures them in class. He grades very nicely and there are a few response papers that are personal opinion that are easy and count as most the grade

Remember that horror story about that professor that does nothing more than read from his crusty old yellow notes. Well, if you want a first hand account, take this teacher. The homework has nothing to do with the lectures. The class is fragmented at best. And, you get loads of busywork that has no purpose other than to be redundant.

Knowledgeable and personable.  Pleasant lecturer who invites student participation and input.  A no-stress instructor who cares about students and does not overburden them.  Also well-versed in Virginia educational policy and teacher licensure regulations.  Helpful, too!
